meta.task: A3 组合适配: NDA+DPLL 混合 vs 单一 NDA / 单一 DPLL (5 seed × 6 场景)
meta.purpose: 验证 NDA (前馈无失锁) + DPLL (闭环高精度) 混合的互补性 (adaptation-scan.md A3)

hybrid_algorithm.step1: NDA-ML per-block 升幂 mean-angle 估块常数粗相位 (无失锁前馈)
hybrid_algorithm.step2: DPLL DD 连续跟踪残余漂移 (全数组 VCO 累积, 守 S011)
hybrid_algorithm.complementarity: NDA 去大块相位减小 DPLL 失锁风险, DPLL 补 NDA per-block 无法跨块跟踪的漂移

fairness.hybrid_vs_nda: γ_d 坐标 (都无 pilot overhead)
fairness.hybrid_vs_dpll: γ_d 坐标 (都无 pilot overhead)
fairness.hybrid_vs_da: γ_tot 坐标 (DA 有 1.249 dB pilot overhead)
fairness.resolve: resolve_m16apsk_blockwise (per-block M0-fold, 同 NDA/DPLL 流程)
fairness.channel_bit_exact: 同 seed 同 generate_shared_realization_apsk 重算 (守 TL-13)

gain_definition.hybrid_vs_nda: fair_gain = (NDA γ_d @ HD-FEC) − (hybrid γ_d @ HD-FEC); 负=混合赢NDA
gain_definition.hybrid_vs_dpll: fair_gain = (DPLL γ_d @ HD-FEC) − (hybrid γ_d @ HD-FEC); 负=混合赢DPLL
